lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a structured grid-like appearance on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique labyrinthine or convoluted 'scribble' patterns consisting of non-circular, high-luminance lines located on the dorsal-lateral surface above the gill slits.
